collection.title: Mercedes-Benz Vito 2003 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz Vito Van 2003 to 2005 (639) will fit, this model requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Heavy Duty Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm and comes pre-fitted with Spray Bars.
